_note: Four extra wordings per request. The original wording from ../tool-call-self-correction/data/tasks.json is phrasing p0; these are p1 to p4. Every wording keeps the same ground truth.

en: Please schedule patient 4417 for 2:30 pm on 3 November 2026, non-urgent.

Can you book 4417 in for 3 Nov 2026, half two in the afternoon? No urgency.

ru: 4417 number patient ka appointment 3 Nov 2026 ko 2:30 baje dopehar ka laga do, urgent nahi.
Patient 4417 ko 3 November 2026 dopahar dhaai bajay ka time de do. Urgent nai hai.
3 November 2026 ko patient no 4417 ki appointment book kr do, dhai baje dopehr. Jaldi wala case nahi.
Patient 4417 ki booking karni hai, 3 Nov 2026, 2:30 PM. Urgent nahin.
